key_points: Sharp AI-sector selloff Thursday (Nov 5) drove MU down ~17% intraday; Friday premarket/after-hours bounce (~4%) is likely technical relief, not fundamental shift
Single GuruFocus headline cites a reported $4.5B Taiwan investment pause — if confirmed, this would be thesis-changing, but no other outlets in the feed corroborate it
Valuation metrics (forward P/E ~3.7x) are at multi-year lows, attracting value-oriented commentary, yet reflect deep cyclical and AI-demand uncertainty
Post-election policy uncertainty and broader AI-investment skepticism dominate near-term sentiment
No earnings, guidance, M&A, or regulatory news in the feed; the move is almost entirely sector/macro driven
